text: APPROVE: `InScript` is now just two simple `if`s (cognitive complexity of about 2), and the extracted helpers keep the same order (template sites, then object sites, then animate sites) and the same conditions. The only thing I couldn't confirm from the diff is that the new parameter types (`IReadOnlySet<string>`, `IReadOnlyDictionary<string,bool>`) match what `GuardBindings`, `ReadsGuard`, `ScriptGuarded` and `Known` accept.
